extracted.name: Vietnamese Childhood Flour Pancakes
extracted.description: I used to eat them a lot in my childhood:)))
instruction_lines: Mix flour, sugar, and egg in a large bowl.
Gradually add water, stirring until the batter is smooth.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Pour spoonfuls of batter into the pan to form small round pancakes.
Fry until golden on both sides, then remove and drain excess oil.
